12/3 Autonomous activists protested the NYT Dealbook Summit, a convention of war criminals and billionaires. 

The New York Times chose a lineup of speakers that perfectly represents their ethos: genocide propagandists, members of the ruling class who profit off the exploitation and murder of the global south, and not one but TWO prime ministers of the illegitimate genocidal zionist state: Benjamin Netanyahu (real last name: Mileikowsky) and Ehud Barak. 🤮

The NYT has failed in its primary responsibility- honestly reporting on the truth , and instead chosen to manufacture consent for genocide and numerous additional human rights violations in Palestine, South Sudan, and the Congo, and for all forms of capitalist exploitation. We stand with the working class, and all oppressed people, and stand against the NYT and their whitewashing of imperialist crimes. 

❌ Refuse to fund lies. #Unsubscribe from the NYT 

📰 Check out article “The New York Times DealBook Summit: Bourgeois Degenerates Discuss Preserving US Imperialism” by @workersworld_party to learn more about this protest 

#NYTComplicit #MediaAccountability #StopTheLies #GenocidePropagandists 

Photos by: @saltwater_elk @jakedietrich
